intro.prompt: Up-tempo rock intro for a news podcast, 10 seconds, instrumental, around 150 BPM. Driving overdriven electric guitar riff, punchy live drums with a big snare, tight bass. Energetic and confident, builds fast and hits a clean final power chord on the last beat.

outro.prompt: Up-tempo rock outro for a news podcast, 10 seconds, instrumental, around 150 BPM, same band sound as the intro: overdriven electric guitar riff, punchy drums, tight bass. Ends on a big final power chord with a cymbal crash and a short natural decay.
